QuestInfo.name: Return to the Spring
QuestInfo.0: It's time to return to the spring.
QuestInfo.1:
Penni seems like he's gotten used to his manifested form. 
Perhaps it'd be best to return to the spring now.
QuestInfo.2:
Now that you've gained more world experience, Penni thinks the last Spirit Guide will happily come out to join you.

Your path back to the Eternal Forest is a bright one.
